howToUse.heroTitle: How To Use Gym Management SaaS
howToUse.heroSubtitle: Complete step-by-step documentation, module workflows, and interactive guides to operate your gym efficiently.
howToUse.searchPlaceholder: Search features (e.g., Add Member, Backup, Currency, Salary, QR Check-in)...
howToUse.setupDesc: Configure your Gym SaaS software branding, currency, branches, and administrator access.
howToUse.step1_1_desc: Navigate to Admin Panel -> Settings -> Website Settings. Upload your gym logo, update address, GST, and contact details.
howToUse.step1_2_desc: Go to Settings -> Currency. Select your country's currency (INR ₹, USD $, EUR €, AED د.إ, GBP £). Values update live.
howToUse.step1_3_desc: Go to Settings -> Branch Management to add locations. Define custom staff roles under Role Management.
howToUse.memberDesc: Manage gym member profiles, membership plan assignments, and daily check-ins.
howToUse.step2_1_desc: Open Members -> Add Member. Fill in contact info and select their membership plan.
howToUse.step2_2_desc: Scan member QR Code at reception or mark daily attendance under Daily Attendance.
howToUse.step2_3_desc: Trainers can create customized Bodybuilding Assessments, Diet Plans, and Workout Routines.
howToUse.staffDesc: Organize gym staff, assign shifts, manage rosters, and compute monthly salaries automatically.
howToUse.step3_1_desc: Open Staff -> Manage Staff. Create accounts for Trainers, Receptionists, or Managers.
howToUse.step3_2_desc: Set morning and evening shift timings under Shift Management.
howToUse.step3_3_desc: Open Staff -> Salary Calculator. Compute salaries based on shifts worked and attendance deductions.
howToUse.plansDesc: Set up membership packages, process payments online/offline, and issue PDF tax invoices.
howToUse.step4_1_desc: Go to Settings -> Plans. Set prices, duration, and discounts.
howToUse.step4_2_desc: Go to Settings -> Payment Gateways to enable Razorpay, UPI, Card, or Paytm.
howToUse.step4_3_desc: Members automatically receive downloadable PDF tax invoices upon payment.
howToUse.inventoryDesc: Track gym merchandise, supplements, equipment, and staff requests.
howToUse.step5_1_desc: Open Inventory. Register gym products and equipment with purchase cost and maintenance dates.
howToUse.step5_2_desc: Staff can submit equipment maintenance requests directly.
howToUse.backupDesc: Ensure complete data protection with automated server backups and safety restores.
howToUse.step6_1_desc: Open Settings -> Backup & Restore. Enable automatic backup and set frequency.
howToUse.step6_2_desc: Click 'Create Backup Now' to generate a complete ZIP package with SQL dumps and files.
howToUse.step6_3_desc: Under Restore Data, select any backup package to restore system data safely.
howToUse.reportsDesc: Analyze business metrics, audit user actions, and request technical support.
howToUse.step7_1_desc: Open Reports -> Sales Report or Attendance Report. Export CSV or PDF analytics.
howToUse.step7_2_desc: Open Audit Logs to review all user logins and settings modifications.
howToUse.step7_3_desc: Submit technical tickets directly to the Super Admin team.
howToUse.faq1_q: How do I change the currency across the entire software?
howToUse.faq1_a: Go to Admin Panel -> Settings -> Currency. Select your country's currency and save.
howToUse.faq2_q: Do automated server backups run if my browser is closed?
howToUse.faq2_a: Yes! Automated backups run on the backend server scheduler independently of your browser.
howToUse.faq3_q: How do members check in using QR code?
howToUse.faq3_a: Scan the member's QR code at reception or under QR Check-in.
howToUse.faq4_q: How does the automatic Salary Calculator work?
howToUse.faq4_a: Open Staff -> Salary Calculator. It computes pay based on shifts worked minus deductions.
howToUse.faq5_q: What happens when a SaaS subscription license expires?
howToUse.faq5_a: You can renew your plan online via Razorpay or submit an offline request under My Subscription.
